prompt: An issue body contains `- [ ] book the venue` and `- [x] send invites`. What happens on the issue page?
explanation: Task list syntax (`- [ ]` / `- [x]`) renders interactive checkboxes and drives a progress bar on the issue — a detail the exam likes because it is specific and visual.

options.text: Checkboxes render and the issue shows a task-progress indicator that updates as boxes are ticked
The lines render as plain hyphen bullets; the brackets are ignored
GitHub opens a pull request for each unticked task
The issue is automatically assigned to the repository owner
